extracted.name: Seafood spice blend
extracted.description: Pack a flavour punch with this spice blend that works beautifully with seafood such as crab. It's inspired by the iconic Old Bay seasoning from Baltimore.
instruction_lines: Combine the sweet smoked paprika, celery salt, English mustard powder, ground white pepper, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, grated nutmeg, allspice, dried bay leaves and a pinch of ground cloves in a small bowl.
